name: low-capability-safe-phase-governance
purpose: Prevent omission, unsafe scope expansion, unsupported claims, and unreviewed release actions when tasks are executed by weaker models.

layers.name: Intent
layers.rule: Every task has one goal, explicit non-goals, bounded scope, and a measurable acceptance condition.

layers.name: Preconditions
layers.rule: The task packet, required files, dependencies, prior task status, and rollback plan must be available before editing.

layers.name: Authority
layers.rule: Authentication, tenant, data, secret, deployment, and destructive changes require human approval.

layers.name: Isolation
layers.rule: One model task uses one worktree; protected paths cannot be edited outside declared scope.

layers.name: Execution
layers.rule: Use the smallest change that satisfies the task; do not combine unrelated refactors or silently change contracts.

layers.name: Evidence
layers.rule: Run every required command, preserve exit status and output summary, and label environment-gated checks as warnings.

layers.name: Review
layers.rule: The implementer cannot be the sole reviewer; a second model or human checks security, tests, scope, and rollback.

layers.name: Handoff
layers.rule: A task is incomplete until changed files, risks, evidence, rollback, and next dependency are recorded.

layers.name: Memory
layers.rule: Record the decision and verification result in DTHINK/memory so the next model does not repeat or forget work.
